assertions.assertion: The denial is under Reason Code PR-204
PR-204 states that Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is not covered under the member's benefit plan
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I25.10
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The service is consistent with the payer's own description of the service
